# Diagnostic — C1: EEI's RON 2.16M Op Income / Capitalized Own Work Omission

> **Read-only diagnostic. NO code was changed.**
> Per your authorization: diagnose, report, do not fix. The fix surface is recorded below for sequencing after the top three closures.

## Headline verdict

**Renderer-side bug, not a parser bug.** Specifically, the standalone HTML report generated by `renderReportHtml` in [scandi-desk-main/src/lib/financialReport.ts](scandi-desk-main/src/lib/financialReport.ts) omits the 722 capitalized-own-work line from both the income-statement table and the KPI strip, and the EBITDA / Net Income headline figures in that report use the operational (722-excluded) view. The 2,164,079.83 is present on the API contract (`is.capitalizedOwnWork`) — the renderer just doesn't read it on that file. Every other consumer of the same data in the FE handles 722 correctly.

## Fixture used

`scandi-desk-main/e2e/fixtures/ground-truth/ro_eei_dec_2025/expected_extraction.json` — the EEI Imobiliara Investment SRL Dec 2025 trial balance, in the engine's standard `{cont, sume_totale_*, sold_final_*}` shape.

Source TB ties at 24,462,228.15 (debit = credit). Total accounts: 64. Class 7 income:

| Code | Name | `ytd_debit` | `ytd_credit` |
|---|---|---|---|
| 706 | VEN. DIN REDEVENTE SI CHIRII (rental) | 2,727,103.68 | 2,727,103.68 |
| **722** | **VEN. DIN PROD. DE IMOBILIZARI CORPORALE** | **2,164,079.83** | **2,164,079.83** |
| 7611 | VEN. DIN ACTIUNI DETINUTE LA ENTITATI AFILIATE | 694,377.16 | 694,377.16 |
| 7651 | VEN. DIN DIFERENTE FAVORABILE DE CURS VALUTAR | 26,632.48 | 26,632.48 |
| 766 | VEN. DIN DOBINZI | 2,460.43 | 2,460.43 |
| 767 | VEN. DIN SCONTURI OBTINUTE | 22,167.00 | 22,167.00 |

The "2.16M op income" the user reported missing is account **722** (capitalized own work), not 758. There is no 758 entry in this fixture.

## Step-by-step trace

### Step 1 — Parser captures 722 correctly

`_trial_balance_parser.py:670` looks up the rule for code `722` → returns the COA mapper entry at `_ro_coa.py:353`:

```python
MappingRule("722", "capitalizedOwnWork", 1, "Producția imobilizări corporale — MEMO"),
```

Bucket = `capitalizedOwnWork`. That bucket is in `CREDIT_POS_PL` (`_trial_balance_parser.py:625`).

The P&L picking logic at `_trial_balance_parser.py:731`:

```python
amount = st_c if abs(st_c) >= abs(st_d) else st_d
```

For 722: `st_c = st_d = 2,164,079.83` (the year-end closing entry zeroes both sides equally). `abs(st_c) >= abs(st_d)` → `True` → `amount = 2,164,079.83`. **Captured exactly.**

Confirmed by feeding the EEI extraction fixture through `accounts_to_assemble_shape` directly — 722 appears in the output list with `amount = 2,164,079.83`.

### Step 2 — Engine canonical surfaces 722 on the right fields

Running EEI through `_ro_coa.assemble_statements`:

```
-- Canonical assembled_pl --
  revenue                       =   2,727,103.68
  capitalized_own_work_memo     =   2,164,079.83   ← THE 2.16M
  total_operating_revenue       =   4,913,350.51   = revenue + 722 + 767
  total_operating_revenue_stat. =   4,913,350.51
  ebitda                        =     -36,676.13   ← cash view (722 excluded)
  ebitda_operational            =     -36,676.13
  ebitda_statutory              =   2,127,403.70   ← includes 722 (methodology primary)
  ebitda_operating_view         =   2,149,570.70
  net_income_statutory          =   1,425,245.58   ← matches acct 121 closing exactly

-- Legacy pl (statements.incomeStatement) --
  revenue              = 2,727,103.68
  costOfGoodsSold      = 0.00
  operatingExpenses    = 2,763,779.81
  depreciation         = 355,606.50
  otherIncome          = 0.00
  capitalizedOwnWork   = 2,164,079.83   ← exposed on the legacy IncomeStatement too
  inventoryVariationMemo = 0.00

-- Canonical assembled_bs --
  total_assets         = 20,183,415.93
  total_equity         =  5,823,953.67
  total_liabilities    = 14,359,462.26
  bs_balance_delta     =      0.00 (0.000%)   ← BS reconciles EXACTLY
```

The engine has the 2.16M on three different fields:
- `statements.incomeStatement.capitalizedOwnWork = 2,164,079.83` (legacy contract)
- `statements.assembled_pl.capitalized_own_work_memo = 2,164,079.83` (canonical)
- `statements.subAggregates.ppe_under_construction = 2,164,079.83` (also surfaces via the contra-BS path because of CIP advances)

**Parser + engine assembly: clean. Nothing lost.**

The bug is exclusively in **the standalone HTML report's income-statement table and KPI strip**. Same file (`financialReport.ts`) contains BOTH the bug (lines 1331-1352, 1397-1417) AND a correct usage (lines 625-640) — the rules/facts builder picks the statutory canonical fields; the HTML renderer hand-rolled by the report template misses them.

### Step 4 — User-visible impact for EEI

What the user reads on the standalone HTML report for EEI Dec 2025 today:

| Tile | Value shown | Correct (statutory) value |
|---|---|---|
| Revenue | 2,727,103.68 | 4,891,183.51 (revenue + 722) |
| EBITDA | **−36,676.13** | **+2,127,403.70** |
| EBITDA margin | −1.3% | +43.5% (of statutory revenue) |
| Net Income | −738,834.25 (operational) | +1,425,245.58 (statutory, matches acct 121) |
| Debt / EBITDA | meaningless (EBITDA negative) | 14,083,315.77 / 2,127,403.70 = 6.62× |

For a real-estate vehicle whose primary value-add is capitalized development (722), the operational view paints a misleading distress picture. The same company, viewed through the in-app `ComprehensiveReport.tsx` page or `FinancialStatements.tsx`, shows correctly. Only the "Print to PDF" / standalone HTML report misrepresents.

## Why the other path looks correct in production

The `buildPLStatementFromAggregates` function at `buildPlStatement.ts:367-415` (used when line items aren't available, or for SAGA sub-account formats) explicitly does:

```ts
const capOwnWork = is.capitalizedOwnWork ?? 0;
...
const totalOperatingRevenue = revenue + capOwnWork;
```

It correctly reads the `capitalizedOwnWork` field already present on the legacy `IncomeStatement`. The same field is sitting unread in `financialReport.ts`'s HTML template.

## Diagnostic confidence

**High.** Three independent confirmations:

1. **Engine end-to-end run on EEI fixture** — assembled output shows 722 captured (`capitalized_own_work_memo = 2,164,079.83`, `ebitda_statutory = 2,127,403.70`, `net_income_statutory = 1,425,245.58`, `bs_balance_delta = 0.00`).
2. **File-by-file trace of every `capitalizedOwnWork` reference** — exactly two consumers (the HTML income table and the HTML KPI strip in `financialReport.ts`) miss the field; all other FE consumers handle it.
3. **Cross-reference against ground truth** — `e2e/fixtures/ground-truth/ro_eei_dec_2025/expected_statements.json` explicitly carries `capitalized_own_work_memo: 2,164,079.83` as a separate line, confirming the methodology contract treats 722 as a visible separate line, not a hidden operational adjustment.

## Recommended fix surface (NOT implemented — pending your sequencing)

Two-line addition in `financialReport.ts` template — plus a one-line EBITDA-source switch on the KPI strip. Rough shape:

1. **Income statement table** (`financialReport.ts:1331-1352`): insert a row for capitalized own work between Revenue and Gross Profit, and (separately) consider whether to display EBITDA as `cash` OR `statutory` for asset-heavy entities. Conservative recommendation: show BOTH (like `ComprehensiveReport.tsx:505-506` does).
2. **KPI strip** (`financialReport.ts:1397-1417`): for asset-heavy reports, prefer `ebitda_statutory` over `t.ebitda`. The recommendations/facts block at line 625 already uses `pick(ap.ebitda_statutory, t.ebitda)` — apply the same pick to the KPI strip.
3. **Document why both views matter**: add a brief inline note explaining the cash-vs-statutory distinction so a future engineer doesn't "simplify" the EBITDA line back to one.

Approximate change size: 5-10 lines in one file. Blast radius limited to the standalone HTML report — every other surface is already correct. Verification path: re-render EEI's HTML report after fix and check that the 2.16M appears, EBITDA shows positive (statutory), and Scandia's report is unchanged (Scandia has no 722, so `capOwnWork == 0` and all conditionals no-op).
